**Finding: missing (medium severity) — transition assistance and data return absent.**

Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) only ends Customer's access, requires delivery of paid Deliverables, and refunds prepaid Fees. It mentions "any agreed transition period" without obligating Vendor to provide transition assistance, and nothing in the document requires return, export, or certified deletion of Customer Data (Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to a non-existent Section 11 plus Section 15, which covers only processing limits).

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: new Section 10.3 requiring (a) up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, (b) return/export of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and (c) subsequent deletion with written certification, subject to routine backups and legal retention. Fallback of 90 days' assistance offered in the comment.
